macros.name: ClearPreHook
macros.doc: To clear all of the tokens in a pre hook use \ClearPreHook{⟨hook⟩}.

macros.name: PopPostHook
macros.doc: The most recently pushed tokens can be popped off using \PopPostHook{⟨hook⟩}.

macros.name: PopPreHook
macros.doc: The most recently pushed tokens can be popped off using \PopPreHook{⟨hook⟩}.

macros.name: PushPreHook
macros.doc: Additional tokens hbalanced texti are prepended to the pre hook ⟨hook⟩ using \PushPreHook{⟨hook⟩}{⟨balanced text⟩}.

macros.name: SavePreHook
macros.doc: To save the pre hook ⟨hook⟩ to the macro \cs, use \SavePreHook{⟨hook⟩}{\cs}.
